title: Weekdays on schedule rules: contracts, agent and editor
goal: A schedule rule runs only on the weekdays it names, also offline
acceptance: Contracts: a rule names its weekdays (default every day), due-day logic tested, PROTOCOL_VERSION bumped
The agent applies it in the tent's time zone without the hub; e2e case
The schedule editor picks days with a weekdays/weekend shortcut and shows weekends apart; light rules from the calendar stay daily
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Built and merged in #27 on green CI 2026-11-24 (another session), before this plan merged. No actual: the step was not timed here.
